BadGateway.description: The billing service rejected the request.

BillingUnavailable.description: The billing service is unreachable — paid-pack entitlements cannot be verified (fail-closed). Retry shortly.

Conflict.description: State conflict — e.g. a lost/mismatched claim token, an already claimed work item, or an immutable-version republish.

FeatureDisabled.description: The document pipeline is dark (DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED off).

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the required scope.

NotFound.description: No such resource in this tenant.

payload.description: Extraction payload. `object`/`clause` of scope-gated fact candidates are redacted for callers without the required predicate scope.

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted billing checkout URL to open.

signature.description: ed25519 signature (base64) over the canonical manifest sans this field.

error.description: Optional diagnostic recorded on the run row (truncated server-side).

permanent.description: Default (false/absent) RELEASES the item back to 'pending'; true marks the run 'failed' — no longer offered, still claimable by runId.

FeatureDisabledResponse.description: Answered by every document-pipeline route while DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED is off.

kind.description: Container kind the connector normalized from (pdf/markdown/email/…). Open string — provenance metadata only.

meta.description: Operator-supplied metadata, projected onto derived facts' source.meta.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 — becomes the derived facts' validFrom.

originUri.description: Pointer back to the raw container (URL, path, message id…).

storeContent.description: Store the normalized chunks server-side. false keeps only contentHash + metadata (no re-index, no span re-validation).

text.description: Normalized document text (DOC_MAX_CHARS may lower the cap).

seedDocuments.description: Present iff the manifest ships seedDocuments — whether their document-pipeline ingest was enqueued. Install never fails because of seeds.

failures.description: Human-readable reasons the fixture failed (empty when passed).

indexerId.description: The pack id this indexer is registered as (mode 'external').

packVersion.description: Optional claim of the pack version; must match the installed one.

runId.description: A claimed work item this submission fulfils. Provided together with claimToken or not at all (claimless flow opens its own run).

commit.description: null when the document vanished between staging and commit.

ungrounded.description: true when the document has no stored content — spans unverifiable.

predicate.description: Must be namespaced `<indexerId>__*` or a core predicate.

bearerAuth.description: API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`); its SHA-256 must be registered in BRAIN_API_KEYS. Keys carry scopes (`brain:read`, `brain:write`, `brain:admin`, `brain:read_pii`, `registry:publish`, `registry:curate`, `indexer:write`) — each operation states the scope it requires. Not an OAuth flow.

info.description: Generated from the zod wire contracts (`pnpm openapi:build` — scripts/build-openapi.ts); do not edit by hand. The admin/ops surface (jobs, leases, policy, stats, maintenance) is documented in docs/api.md instead. Scopes are plain bearer-key grants, not OAuth flows — each operation states its required scope.
info.summary: The community-facing platform surface: Domain Pack registry, tenant pack admin, document ingest, the external-indexer work protocol, and source reputation reads.
info.title: INITE Brain — Platform API

get.description:
Builtin packs are globally available and cannot be installed or uninstalled here. Source: src/admin/admin-packs.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.
get.summary: List available + installed packs for this tenant

post.description:
Validates and installs a community / custom manifest, seeding its predicates. `expectedChecksum` pins the exact content.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.
post.summary: Install a pack manifest into this tenant

post.description:
Resolves the manifest (latest non-yanked, or a pinned version) and installs it with the registry checksum pinned — the installed content is exactly what the registry served. A PAID pack without an active `domain_pack:<packId>` entitlement answers 402 with a self-describing hint (the checkout route to call, then retry); while the billing service is unreachable, paid installs fail CLOSED with 503.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.

402.description: Paid pack, no entitlement — purchase via the checkout route in the hint, then retry.

post.summary: Install a pack from the global registry

delete.description:
Deprecates the pack's predicates; facts extracted with them survive.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.
delete.summary: Uninstall a pack from this tenant

post.description:
Scores whether extraction (with the pack's predicates + extractionProfile active) still meets the pack’s own expectations. Runs up to MAX_EVAL_FIXTURES live LLM calls — throttled to 3 requests/min per credential.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.

parameters.description: 'union' (default) scores the shared union prompt; 'dedicated' runs the pack-scoped dedicated prompt instead.
parameters.name: mode

post.summary: Run a pack's eval fixtures against the live extractor

post.description:
Versions are immutable once published. Republishing an identical (packId, version, checksum) is idempotent (`created: false`); a different body for an existing version is rejected. Source: src/registry/admin-registry.controller.ts.

Required scope: `registry:publish`.
post.summary: Publish a pack version to the global registry

post.description:
Creates a billing checkout session for the BUYING tenant (the caller's company is the billing userId). Open `checkoutUrl`, pay, then retry POST /v1/admin/packs/from-registry — the 402 hint on that route points here. Answers 400 for a free pack or while the billing integration is disabled. An `idempotency-key` header is forwarded to billing so client retries collapse into one order. Throttled to 10 requests/min per credential.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.
post.summary: Start a hosted checkout for a paid pack

post.description:
Surfaces the pack in the featured section on top of the catalogue listing and /registry/ui. Instance-local; never mirrored.

Required scope: `registry:curate`.

delete.description:
Clears the paid flag — installs stop requiring an entitlement. Billing products/prices are immutable and stay.

Required scope: `registry:publish`.

put.description:
Marks the pack paid: ensures the billing product exists (entitlement key `domain_pack:<packId>`), mints a fresh immutable price, and stores the priceCode + display price in the instance-local registry meta. Only the company that published the pack may price it. Answers 400 while the billing integration is disabled. Source: src/registry/marketplace-admin.controller.ts.

Required scope: `registry:publish`.

post.summary: Remove a pack from the featured section

post.description:
Reverses a yank — the version becomes installable again.

Required scope: `registry:publish`.

Marks a version as not-installable (existing installs keep working). The version stays visible in the history, flagged.

Required scope: `registry:publish`.

put.description:
Full-replace upsert. Writable ONLY by a company that has published at least one VERIFIED pack under the publisher id — the ed25519 signature validated against the hosting instance's trust store is what ties a company to the publisher name (403 otherwise).

Required scope: `registry:publish`.

get.description:
Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`. Source: src/documents/documents.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

parameters.description: Pass `1` to include the stored chunks. The raw text can carry any PII, so this additionally requires the `brain:read_pii` scope (403 otherwise).
parameters.name: includeText

get.summary: Read a document header and its indexer runs

get.description:
Every extraction candidate staged against the document, over all runs. `object`/`clause` of fact candidates whose predicate requires a scope the caller lacks are redacted; the row stays visible for the audit trail. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

post.description:
A remote indexer that read a stored document submits its reading here. With `runId` + `claimToken` the submission fulfils a claimed work item; without them it opens its own run (claimless flow). Candidates are grounded against the stored text; the Brain commits once every run for the document is settled. Max 200 items per kind. Throttled to 10 requests/min per credential. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`. Source: src/documents/external-candidates.controller.ts.

Required scope: `indexer:write`.
post.summary: Stage an external indexer's candidate batch

get.description:
Verbatim pre-extraction dialogue turns in stable (occurredAt, id) order — the raw layer any consumer can build its own projection from. Callers without `brain:read_pii` see only episodes whose piiClass is empty. 404 until EPISODES_API_ENABLED=1. Source: src/episodes/episodes.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor from the previous page (`nextCursor`).
parameters.name: cursor

get.description:
The same filtered stream as GET /v1/episodes, one episode per line, paged internally — bounded memory however large the tenant. 404 until EPISODES_API_ENABLED=1.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

200.description: NDJSON stream; each line is an Episode.

get.description:
Secrets are never included. 404 until EPISODE_SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED=1.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

post.description:
Registers an http(s) endpoint for `episodes_available` pushes (see the EpisodesAvailableEvent schema and the top-level webhooks section). The HMAC signing secret is returned exactly once. Pushes carry METADATA ONLY — bodies are pulled through GET /v1/episodes under the subscriber’s own scopes. Delivery is at-least-once. 404 until EPISODE_SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED=1.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.

get.description:
The fact itself — what is remembered, where it came from (vertical/recorder/conversation), its validity instant and user scope. Every visibility fence (tenant, user scope, row policy) answers 404 — existence never leaks. 404 until FACTS_API_ENABLED=1. Source: src/facts/facts.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

The verbatim source turns (`source.episodeIds`) the fact was derived or ingested from, chronological, text capped server-side. Callers without `brain:read_pii` never receive PII-classed episode text. Same 404 fences as GET /v1/facts/{id}. 404 until FACTS_API_ENABLED=1.

Required scope: `brain:read`.
get.summary: Read the grounding episodes behind a fact

get.description:
Pending indexer runs routed to this tenant’s installed external packs. Protocol: docs/indexer-protocol.md. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`. Source: src/documents/indexer-work.controller.ts.

Required scope: `indexer:write`.

parameters.description: Only work for this external pack.
parameters.name: packId

get.summary: Poll for pending external work items

post.description:
Atomically transitions the run to claimed and returns the claimToken that fences all subsequent calls. Heartbeat within leaseSeconds or the claim is reaped as abandoned. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`.

Required scope: `indexer:write`.

get.description:
Serves the verbatim stored chunks of the claimed document — only for documents whose ingest routed to this tenant’s installed external packs. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`.

Required scope: `indexer:write`.
get.summary: Read the claimed document's stored content

post.description:
Default RELEASES the item back to 'pending' (transient trouble, shutdown mid-work); `permanent: true` marks the run 'failed' — no longer offered. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`.

Required scope: `indexer:write`.
post.summary: Release or permanently fail a claim

post.description:
Extends the lease of a claimed work item. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`.

Required scope: `indexer:write`.

Source → Indexer → Candidates → Brain: stores + chunks the text, runs the selected indexers, commits grounded candidates as facts. `mode: "async"` fans out per-indexer queue jobs instead (requires DOCUMENT_MULTI_INDEXER_ENABLED). Throttled to 10 requests/min per credential. Part of the document pipeline — answers `503 feature_disabled` until `DOCUMENT_INGEST_ENABLED=1`. Source: src/documents/documents-ingest.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:write`.

201.description: Ingest outcome — shape follows the requested `mode`.

get.description:
Every derived world (facts@version, …) with its lifecycle status (building/built/live/residual/failed), watermark, builder identity and stats, plus the process-local read pin (RETRIEVAL_DERIVED_VERSION). A registry row promises a queryable world. 404 until PROJECTIONS_API_ENABLED=1. Source: src/admin/projections.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.
get.summary: List derived surfaces and the live read pin

post.description:
The public verb over the maintenance batch engine. v1 rebuilds `facts` (the session-window deriver): derives into the given version (a paid, operator-invoked batch), optionally flips the live read pin (`activate`). Rewriting the pinned world needs `force`. 404 until PROJECTIONS_API_ENABLED=1.

Required scope: `brain:admin`.

get.description:
Lists published packs (latest installable version each). The catalogue is shared across all tenants; any authenticated key may browse. Source: src/registry/registry.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

parameters.name: q

All published versions of a pack, newest first, including yanked ones (flagged).

get.description:
The publisher profile (when one was written — see PUT /v1/admin/registry/publishers/{publisher}) plus the publisher's catalogue entries. 404 only when the publisher is entirely unknown (no profile AND no packs). Source: src/registry/registry.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.
get.summary: A publisher's public page as JSON

get.description:
Catalogue of everything brain knows ABOUT its fact sources: the operator-declared identity (type, authLevel) joined with the learned agreement rates, one row per sourceKey. Public projection — operator annotations (owner/note) are served only on the brain:admin surface. `domain` additionally captures that domain's learned rate into `domainTrust` and makes `minSamples` judge it (falling back to the global row). Source: src/sources/public-sources.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

parameters.description: Capture this domain’s learned rate per source (`domainTrust`).
parameters.name: domain

parameters.description: Only sources declared with this type.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Only sources whose learned rate rests on at least this many samples (domain-scoped row when `domain` is given, global row otherwise).
parameters.name: minSamples

get.description:
Declared type/authLevel, every learned scope (global first, then domains alphabetically), and the reputation-over-time trail (newest first, capped at 50 rows). Public projection — owner/note are excluded. Same data the `get_source_reputation` MCP tool serves.

Required scope: `brain:read`.
get.summary: One source’s declared identity, trust scopes, and history

get.description:
Query-time assembly of what the platform knows about a user: active user-scoped facts grouped by aspect (persona-first), plus `profileText` shaped for direct prompt injection. Deterministic — no model calls. A user-bound token may only fetch its own profile (mismatch 403); M2M tokens any. 404 until USER_PROFILE_API_ENABLED=1. Source: src/users/user-profile.controller.ts.

Required scope: `brain:read`.

parameters.description: The user whose profile to assemble.
parameters.name: userId

post.description: Brain POSTs this to every registered subscription endpoint when fresh episodes land. Metadata only — never episode text. Signed `X-Brain-Signature: sha256=<hex hmac>` over the raw JSON body with the per-subscription secret. Delivery is at-least-once (dedupe on episode ids); the watermark advances only after a 2xx.
